pages.text: $(l)Base cap is 30.$()$(li)Singularity Master manual: $(l)35$(), at the very start of Chapter 4$(li)Draconic Key: $(l)40$(), near the end of Chapter 4$(li)Ancient Elven Knowledge: $(l)45$(), in Chapter 6$(li)Vethea Binding: $(l)60$(), in Chapter 7
$(li)Tome of Astral Mastery: $(l)100$(), Chapter 10 bonus postgame content

$(l)Caps are also tied to key items:$()$(li)Singularity Master Manual → $(l)35$()$(li)Draconic Key → $(l)40$()$(li)Ancient Elven Knowledge → $(l)45$()$(li)Vethea Binding → $(l)60$()$(li)Tome of Astral Mastery → $(l)100$()

$(l)Reaching level 100 is not feasible with normal XP gain alone.$()$(li)Exponential XP curve makes manual leveling to 100 impractical$(li)The Tome of Astral Mastery is required to reach the highest cap
$(li)If the Tome of Astral Mastery is stuck at level 60, try restarting the game—it may be a client-side desync issue.
